name: warpline
description: The Claude Code on-ramp to warpline: companion skills that pick up [needs-llm] handoffs, and one that walks an operator through approving a bundled example's bytes.

plugins.name: warpline
plugins.description: Companion skills for warpline's [needs-llm] handoffs — needs-llm scans delegated runs, feed-triage does the judgment. Installs the skills only; the warpline runtime itself is a separate npm package.

plugins.name: warpline-examples
plugins.description: Companion skill for warpline's bundled content-approval examples: approve-review shows an operator the exact bytes cadence-send or candidate-promote would ship, and runs warpline approve --content only on an explicit yes.
